title: Why crabs refuse to walk forward
topic: Crab Logic Ep. 1: Sol tries walking straight forward like a surface human; Vera and Moss explain why sideways is undefeated
hookHeadline: I tried walking straight forward like a surface human today.

scenes.speaker: sol
scenes.line: I tried walking straight forward like a surface human today.
scenes.description: Three-shot on the sea floor: Sol stands proudly in a strut while Moss and Vera stare sideways at him.

scenes.speaker: vera
scenes.line: Why would you walk straight toward your problems?
scenes.description: Close-up on Vera looking left across the sand, deeply unimpressed.

scenes.speaker: sol
scenes.line: It felt bold. Very exposed. I hated every second.
scenes.description: Close-up on Sol shrugging and flinching at the word 'exposed'.

scenes.speaker: moss
scenes.description: Close-up on Moss facing the camera calmly.

scenes.speaker: moss
scenes.line: You can leave any conversation without turning around.
scenes.description: Slow push-in on Moss delivering deadpan crustacean wisdom.

scenes.speaker: vera
scenes.line: Evolution got it right five times.
scenes.description: Extreme close-up on Vera snapping straight into the lens right before the hard cut.

caption:
Walking straight forward is a design flaw.

Sol tried it once. Never again.
